predecessors.name: Dachanghe
predecessors.text: Dali's land in Yunnan, shape of 947 used from 937

successors.name: Mongol Empire
successors.text: Dali's land, taken by the Mongols 1253-1256 and made into Yunnan province

ledger.x: 937: Duan Siping founds the Dali Kingdom.
1094: Gao Shengtai seizes the throne and renames the state Dazhong ('coup by Gao Shengtai in 1094').

wars.name: Zhizhi's attack on Dai Viet
wars.outcome: c.1137: Zhizhi with 3,000 Dali troops attacked Ly Anh Tong and was defeated (Dali page; the page says 'c.1137' and gives no front).

wars.name: Mongol conquest of Dali
wars.outcome: Mongke put Kublai in charge; three columns, Kublai crossing the Jinsha at night; they converged on the city of Dali in late 1253; Duan Xingzhi fled to Shanchan and surrendered in 1256; Uriyangkhadai set up brigades.

certainty.note: No page opened gives a boundary of Dali; Cliopatria's shape is carried as drawn (Yunnan plus fringes) and checked only against the Dadu River statement.
